scope: Authorization, revocation, terminal-state and resource-conservation matrix for the model->Main browser loop.

matrix.evidence: bridge unit: a session owned by owner-A asked for by owner-B returns E_OWNER_MISMATCH and the service is never touched
bridge unit: a session without owner metadata returns E_OWNER_MISSING
adapter unit: the facade cache is keyed by workspace root, so two workspaces never share refs/baselines
downloadFile/uploadFiles/readDialogs/respondDialog are not advertised and are refused (UNSUPPORTED) before any effect

matrix.criterion: grant revoked -> action stops and cannot be replayed
matrix.evidence: desktop: after downgrading session A to normal_restricted, takeSnapshot(A) is rejected and a second identical call is still rejected

matrix.criterion: revocation scoped to the owned session
matrix.evidence: desktop: session B still snapshots after A is revoked

matrix.criterion: terminal state not rewritten by late calls
matrix.evidence: task-service unit: completed/cancelled outcomes survive late lifecycle calls

matrix.criterion: unknown outcome does not retry the mutation via another backend
matrix.evidence: tool unit: the mutation dispatches exactly once and no other mutating action is issued
tool unit: an E_STALE_REF result is returned as an error, not a pass
desktop: closing A leaves exactly B in the session list; after closing B the list is empty

limitations: Ownership is enforced on the Gateway path (the renderer IPC surface is the local user surface and carries no owner key by design).
Path and dialog capabilities are still unavailable, so their boundary is proven by refusal rather than by an allowed/denied pair.
Vault/secure-storage conservation is covered by the existing task/session conservation suite, not re-measured here.
